cross_paper_synthesis.condition_dependencies: The clustering behavior is noted to be condition-dependent on the Aluminum concentration (x < 0.5) in the experimental context, while the theoretical spinodal divergence is dependent on the specific maximum wavevector in the simulation context.
cross_paper_synthesis.contradictions: No genuine contradictions exist between the answers; they simply represent different modalities (experimental observation vs. theoretical formulation) of the same problem, both failing to provide the specific numerical values requested.
